jobs.description:
About us European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) GmbH is
the joint venture between TSMC, Bosch, Infineon and NXP. For the first
time, global technology leader TSMC is building a semiconductor fab in
the heart of Europe, offering cutting-edge manufacturing technologies
for next-generation semiconductor products. ESMC represents a shared
commitment to strengthening the European semiconductor ecosystem. For
our future fab in Dresden, we are looking for a highly motivated and
committed: Facilities Technician / Betriebstechniker (Electrical
Systems) (m/f/d) As Facilities Technician you are responsible for
operating, maintaining, and troubleshooting of electrical systems for
all power up to and including 110kV including Site Substations,
Service Entry Sections, Electrical switchgear, Panelboards,
Transformers, cabling systems, metering circuits, diesel generators,
uninterruptable power supply (UPS), Power Distribution Unit (PDU),
Remote Power Panel (RPP), and Static Transfer Switch (STS) as well as
motor connections, Motors and electrical controls. You play the
pivotal role to ensure standard operating procedures are followed
accurately and reliably to ensure our fab follows highest
environmental protection standards. By performing laboratory testing
and systematic verification and alignment of measurements from various
instruments, sensors, and equipment our fab can run smoothly thanks to
your work. Tasks Maintains a clean, orderly, and safe workplace,
follow all safety policies and procedures at all times and make
recommendations for continuous improvement of work method, safety,
materials-, and tool handling. Monitors operation of the mechanical /
electrical operating equipment. Observes gauges, signals and recording
instruments turns valves, moves controls to regulate temperatures,
pressures, flow of heating water, coolant to effectively monitor
critical limits. Performs standard diagnostics, monitor site
performance indicators and perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for
interruptions or incidents. Performs troubleshooting, emergency and
corrective maintenance and repair actions. Performs diagnostic to
determine root cause and corrective actions needed to maintain systems
operation within specifications in conformity with plant standards.
Maintains log of gauge readings, shift throughput, and equipment
malfunctions. Patrols area to inspect equipment and record tank levels
and gauge readings. Ensures processing conditions and process output
are within regulatory limits and alerting management of discrepancies.
Perform standard and non-standard equipment maintenance, repairs and
modifications to ensure smooth operations inline with environmental
protection requirements. Profile Qualifications and Education:
Eligible to work in Germany and available for 3 months on-the-job
training in Taiwan. Technician or equivalent technical apprenticeship
education as electrician, in Mechatronics or a related field. Minimum
2–3 years of experience in a facilities, utilities, or electrical
related role. Qualified electrician to effectively detect and repair
defects in the operation of plant electrical equipment. Willingness to
work in a cleanroom environment with rotating shifts or on-call
duties. Deep interest in mechanical, chemical, and electrical
principles related to mechanical systems. Language Skills: Good
command of English with good command of German to communicate in our
international workplace. Professional Skills: Knowledge of industry
standards, codes and regulations, and the ability to apply to
maintenance operation of site Electrical systems. Functional level
knowledge of Electrical theory to troubleshoot and repair electrical
controls and electrical power distribution systems, complex procedures
pertinent to equipment and power distribution and wiring repair.
Operational knowledge of medium and high voltage cabling systems,
understanding the hazards associated with the specific class of system
voltage, and being able to mitigate these hazards through safe working
practices. Basic computer skills, ability to learn usage of standard
maintenance and process monitoring software. Able to read and
interpret technical manuals and process schematics. Capable of working
independently and cooperatively with other Technicians, Engineers, and
Managers with a strong attention to detail, documentation accuracy,
and problem-solving. Personal Attributes: Having strong values of
honesty, integrity and respect for others. We offer Each journey
starts with a first step. Joining ESMC at this early stage will
provide you with the unique opportunity to actively shape the future
of the fab in Dresden, boost your career and put your true potential
to the test. You will be working in a fast paced, international
startup environment whilst at the same time having access to the
experience, talent, and resources of the largest and most advanced
semiconductor manufacturer in the world, TSMC. You have ample
opportunities to learn about TSMC Operations, Digital Transformation,
and various advanced Facilities related topics, both in Taiwan and
other sites around the world. Behind the world’s most advanced
technology are real people with real passion. Our success is fueled by
our core values: Integrity, Commitment, Innovation and Customer Trust
(ICIC). At ESMC we believe in the power of inclusive leadership and
passion. We demonstrate this in our commitment to our people vision:
create an inclusive environment to inspire passion and enable the best
in YOU. It is the policy of ESMC to provide equal employment
opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, ethnic and
national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability,
race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender
identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status,
status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other
characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. Additional

jobs.occupation: International Logistics Specialist (Import/Export) (m/f/d) (Kaufmann/-frau - Groß- und Außenhandel (Außenhandel))
jobs.description:
About us Die European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) GmbH
ist das Joint Venture von TSMC, Bosch, Infineon und NXP. Erstmals
errichtet der weltweite Technologieführer TSMC eine Halbleiterfabrik
im Herzen Europas, die kleinste Fertigungstechnologien für
Halbleiterprodukte der nächsten Generation bietet. ESMC steht für
das gemeinsame Engagement zur Stärkung des europäischen
Halbleiter-Ökosystems. Für unsere zukünftige Fab in Dresden suchen
wir eine/n hochmotivierte/n und engagierte/n: International Logistics
Specialist (Import/Export) (m/f/d) At ESMC, we are building a
state-of-the-art semiconductor fab in Dresden. As part of our
international Supply Chain organization, you will play a key role in
establishing efficient global logistics processes that ensure the
reliable movement of materials, equipment and goods across
international borders. This position offers the opportunity to shape
logistics processes from the ground up in an international greenfield
environment while working closely with colleagues, logistics providers
and customs authorities around the world. Tasks Manage international
import and export shipments for the Dresden fab and related locations.
Coordinate daily logistics operations together with freight forwarders
and logistics service providers. Support customs clearance activities
and ensure compliant import and export processes. Review
logistics-related invoices and payment processes within SAP. Monitor
logistics service providers against agreed KPIs and support continuous
performance improvements. Collaborate closely with internal
departments, suppliers, customs authorities and international
logistics partners. Support the implementation and harmonization of
global logistics processes and systems. Identify opportunities to
improve logistics, customs and global trade processes in a rapidly
growing manufacturing environment. Contribute to establishing scalable
logistics structures within our greenfield project. Profile Required:
Bachelor’s or Master´s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain
Management, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering or a
comparable qualification. Several years of professional experience
(approximately 7+ years) in international logistics, import/export,
customs or global trade. Strong knowledge of customs regulations and
international import/export processes. Practical experience
coordinating international shipments. Experience working with customs
brokers, freight forwarders and logistics providers. Strong
communication skills and experience working with international
stakeholders. Fluent German and good English skills. Nice to have:
Experience within semiconductor, electronics, automotive or other
manufacturing industries. Experience with SAP, ideally SAP S/4HANA.
Knowledge of export control regulations. Mandarin language skills. We
offer Help build a completely new semiconductor manufacturing site in
Europe. Work in a highly international environment with colleagues
across Europe, Taiwan and the US. Shape logistics processes instead of
maintaining existing structures. Participate in global projects and
cross-functional collaboration. International onboarding including
4–6 weeks of training in Taiwan and Arizona. Additional contact
details Please apply with your English resume. The ESMC recruiting
team will get in touch with you if your candidacy fits the hiring
criteria.

About us European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) is a
joint venture between four technology leaders, TSMC, Bosch, Infineon
and NXP, to establish a state-of-the-art semiconductor fab in the
heart of Europe. ESMC represents our shared commitment to
strengthening the European semiconductor ecosystem. To help us build
the foundation of our future fab in Dresden, we are looking for a
highly motivated and passionate (m/f/d): Senior Equipment Hook-Up
Engineer As a Senior Equipment Hook-Up Engineer, you will be
coordinating all hook-up activities from planning, construction, and
commissioning of faculty media supplies (gases, chemicals, exhaust
air, ultra-pure water, wastewater, electricity) from the base build
supply connection to the process equipment at our new state-of-the-art
semiconductor fab in Dresden. Your role will ensure system safety,
reliability, efficiency, and compliance while driving continuous
improvement and innovation. You will collaborate with internal teams
and external service providers. Tasks New challenges: Become part of
the facility team to build ESMC's 300mm semiconductor fab. System
Ownership & Optimization: Develop and manage detailed schedules for
equipment hookups, coordinating with equipment vendors, construction
teams, contract vendor management, and facility engineers to ensure
seamless integration in compliance with environmental and safety
regulations. Technical Expertise: Review and approve hookup designs
and engineering plans, ensuring compliance with industry standards and
project specifications. Experience in electrical, process colling
water, ultra-pure water, Gas & Chemical, and other Plastic utility
systems. Data-Driven Decision Making: Monitor and report on the
progress of hookup activities to senior management, addressing any
issues or delays proactively. Project Involvement: Support system
design, construction, and commissioning for new facility installations
and upgrades. Continuous Improvement & Cost Optimization: Plan,
coordinate, and execute strategies to accelerate hookup progress.
Identify opportunities for cost savings, reliability improvements, and
integration of best practices. Collaboration: Lead a team of
technicians and contractors, providing guidance, training, and
performance evaluations. Communicate with cross function engineers or
venders. Profile Job Qualifications: Qualifications and Education:
Degree in Electrical, Chemical, Mechanical or Automation Engineering
or a related field Must have experience: 10+ years of experience in
equipment hookup or facility engineering within the semiconductor
industry. Proven track record in managing large-scale construction or
installation projects. Familiarity with semiconductor fabrication
processes and equipment. Language Skills: Fluent German and English
language skills. Professional Skills: Proficient with Microsoft
Office, discipline-specific software (i.e., AutoCAD, Revit, etc.).
Personal Attributes: Strong analytical thinking and highly effective
interpersonal and communication skills when interacting with others.
Location: Dresden, Germany. What we offer Each journey starts with a
first step. Joining ESMC at this early stage will provide you with the
unique opportunity to actively shape the future of the fab in Dresden,
boost your career and unlock your potential. Work in a fast paced,
international startup environment while at the same time having access
to the experience, talent, and resources of the largest and most
advanced semiconductor manufacturer in the world, TSMC. At ESMC, we
create an inclusive environment to inspire passion and enable the best
in YOU. It is the policy of ESMC to provide equal employment
opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, ethnic and
national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability,
race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender
identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status,
status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other
characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. Contact
Please apply with English resume

About us Die European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) GmbH
ist das Joint Venture von TSMC, Bosch, Infineon und NXP. Erstmals
errichtet der weltweite Technologieführer TSMC eine Halbleiterfabrik
im Herzen Europas, die kleinste Fertigungstechnologien für
Halbleiterprodukte der nächsten Generation bietet. ESMC steht für
das gemeinsame Engagement zur Stärkung des europäischen
Halbleiter-Ökosystems. Für unsere zukünftige Fab in Dresden suchen
wir eine/n hochmotivierte/n und engagierte/n: Quality Management &
Document Control Engineer (m/f/d) Are you ready to shape the quality
standards of a state-of-the-art semiconductor fab from the ground up?
As a Quality Management & Document Control Engineer (m/f/d) at ESMC,
you will bridge the gap between our Taiwanese headquarters and our
brand-new greenfield facility in Dresden. Starting on January 2027,
you will own the Document Control System, ensure compliance with
international quality standards, and coordinate internal, customer,
and third-party audits. By running trainings and cross-departmental
programs, you will champion a proactive quality culture across the
Fab. If you are a detail-oriented professional with initial QA
experience looking to make a lasting impact on Europe’s
semiconductor ecosystem, we want you on our team! Tasks System
Ownership: Administer and maintain the site-wide Document Control
System (DCS) to guarantee database integrity, document effectiveness,
and smooth annual document review processes. Audit Management:
Independently plan, execute, and follow up on internal quality audits,
customer audits, and third-party quality system certifications.
Continuous Improvement: Track and drive the implementation of
corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs) resulting from audits and
quality reviews. Promote Quality Culture: Collaborate with the Fab
engineering and manufacturing teams to develop and host
quality-related training sessions, workshops, and symposiums. HQ
Collaboration: Leverage resources, documentation standards, and best
practices from our headquarters to build a reliable local quality
framework. Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all document management and
quality processes comply with German/European regulations, customer
requirements, and standard quality frameworks. Profile Must-Have:
Education: Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Engineering, Natural
Sciences, Quality & Reliability, or a related technical field.
Experience: 1 to 3 years of professional experience in the
semiconductor, automotive, or highly regulated electronics
manufacturing industries with a focus on Quality Systems (QS) or
Quality Assurance (QA). Methodology & Tools: Solid familiarity with
standard Quality Control tools, 8D problem-solving methodologies, and
core automotive quality tools (such as SPC, MSA, FMEA, APQP, PPAP).
Languages: Fluency in English (written and spoken) for daily
international collaboration. Working Style: Highly organized,
detail-oriented, and resilient under pressure in a fast-paced
environment. Nice-to-Have: Initial experience or certified
qualification as an auditor (e.g., ISO 9001, IATF 16949, or VDA 6.3).
Basic programming/querying skills in SQL (Structured Query Language)
for quality data extraction. Familiarity with the local German
business ecosystem and manufacturing regulations. Basic conversational
skills in German and/or Mandarin. We offer Help build a completely new
semiconductor manufacturing site in Europe. Work in a highly
international environment with colleagues across Europe, Taiwan and
the US. Shape processes instead of maintaining existing structures.
Participate in global projects and cross-functional collaboration.
International onboarding including approximately 9-12 months of
training in Taiwan. Additional contact details Please apply with your
English resume.

As the leading company in the field of software solutions for healthcare, we operate in 19 countries and employ over 9,000 dedicated staff members. You will work in a dynamic and innovative environment full of opportunities. With your commitment and passion, you have the chance to make a sustainable difference.

CGM Leverages AI: We’re looking for people who feel the power of AI in the e-health environment, who want to help shape change, and who are driven by a curious passion to see how technology can make healthcare smarter, simpler, and better.

Together, we are shaping the healthcare system of the future. Become part of our mission and make a difference - for a world where knowledge saves lives!

Are you passionate about groundbreaking products? Do you have the talent to turn ideas into real, valuable solutions-while always keeping the bigger picture in mind? Then we’d love to meet you!

You take end-to-end accountability for a large, distributed engineering organization that owns our ambulatory SaaS solutions and the shared framework modules used across all AIS DE products.

You co-define and drive the strategic product-technology roadmap for our cloud-based ambulatory portfolio in close collaboration with the executive leadership team.

You ensure that healthcare regulatory requirements-including medical device regulations, audits, and compliance-are rigorously embedded into product development, delivery, and operations.

You lead senior leaders and cross-functional teams, continuously increasing scalability, quality, AI maturity, and innovation velocity across products and platforms.

You represent the domain internally and externally, build strong executive-level stakeholder relationships, and position CGM as a leading SaaS provider in the Health-IT market.

Long-standing leadership experience at Director / VP / CTO level in SaaS product development, ideally with responsibility for large, distributed engineering organizations and complex product portfolios.

Exceptional academic background with a completed university degree and excellent grades, preferably in computer science, medical informatics, engineering, or a comparable technical field.

Deep expertise in cloud architectures and SaaS platforms, including modern DevOps practices and reliability engineering; hands-on experience with healthcare regulations (medical devices, audits, certifications) is a strong advantage.

Proven track record of driving AI adoption in engineering organizations, ideally with first-hand familiarity of Claude Code or comparable agentic coding tools (agents, skills, and workflows) and experience shaping AI pipelines, harnesses, and context engineering at organizational scale.

Excellent English and very good German, a strategic and entrepreneurial mindset, strong execution focus, outstanding leadership and communication skills, and the ability to guide complex organizations through transformation while staying clearly aligned with our healthcare purpose.

Mobile work: Work flexibly on the move two days a week and on site three days a week.

Attractive locations: In addition to fully equipped workplaces, regular events such as summer parties and Christmas parties await you at our locations.

Development: Our in-house academy and our portfolio of external cooperation partners will support you in your further development.

Health: Health is a valuable asset for us. Our in-house canteen offers a selection of tasty and healthy dishes every day, and we welcome you to our fully equipped fitness center for weekly courses (online & offline).

More is always possible: The kindergarten on our CGM campus in Koblenz helps our employees to organize their working day even more flexibly. We also offer corporate benefits, the option of a job bike, a company pension scheme, and much more.

Diversity is part of CGM! We look forward to receiving your application regardles...

You will work in a dynamic and innovative environment full of opportunities. With your commitment and passion, you have the chance to make a sustainable difference.

You design and develop high-end C++ components for our medical desktop applications, with a strong focus on performance, stability, and scalability.

You architect, implement, and review complex multithreading and parallelization concepts to ensure efficient, safe, and responsive execution in everyday clinical use.

You analyze, refactor, and optimize our large existing codebase (QT, CMake, Conan, MSVC, and embedded CEF), identify bottlenecks, and systematically raise the performance and quality of long-lived products.

You work closely with Architecture, QA, and Product Management, drive the modernization away from legacy MFC / ATL / Win32 and Delphi towards modern C++ and current .NET, and actively raise the overall C++ engineering bar.

You use AI agents and tools like Claude Code in your daily work to accelerate refactoring, code analysis, and legacy modernization, and you continuously improve our shared agents, skills, and workflows.

Several years of senior-level experience in professional C++ development, ideally in high-performance, highly parallelized desktop systems with significant ownership and end-to-end responsibility.

Excellent academic background with a completed university degree in computer science, mathematics, physics, electrical engineering, or a comparable technical discipline with very good grades.

Deep expertise in modern C++ (C++ 14/17/20), multithreading and concurrency, debugging and performance tuning, plus hands-on experience with Qt, CMake, Conan, MSVC, and integrating components such as CEF; confident, effective use of AI in software engineering, ideally including Claude Code or similar agentic coding tools as well as AI pipelines and context engineering.
Fluent German and fluent English, both in spoken communication and in writing, enabling you to work seamlessly in cross-functional, international teams and with German-speaking stakeholders.
A structured, analytical way of working, high-quality standards, strong problem-solving skills, innovation drive, proactive ownership and a pronounced sense of entrepreneurship with genuine enthusiasm for shaping the future of healthcare IT.

Your new team: As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be a key contributor in a cross-functional product team where your work has real, visible impact. You will design, build, and maintain our mobile applications using React Native, with a strong focus on Android, helping deliver high-quality, scalable mobile experiences.

You will collaborate closely with product, design, and business stakeholders, share your technical expertise with peers, and help raise the bar for code quality and engineering excellence. If you enjoy clean architecture, thoughtful problem-solving, and building software that truly matters, this is the role for you.
What you can expect:
• Build and evolve mobile solutions: Design, develop, and maintain high-quality React Native applications.
